senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; הָלַךְ)going, going away; walking; run.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 8b:6">Pes. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>בהֲלִיכָתָן</he> on their going (opp. <cite ref="H00544"><he>חזירה</he></cite>, return).
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:26">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תרבה בה׳</he> do not walk too much.
<cite ref="Sotah 12b:3">Sot. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ה׳ זו וכ׳</he> this ‘going’ (<cite ref="Exodus 2:5">Ex. II, 5</cite>) means death.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:2">Ḥull. I, 2</cite> <he>בדרך הֲלִיכָתָהּ</he> in the direction in which its indentations run (not against them); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:2:3">Y. B. Kam. X, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>שגְזֵלוֹ מן הה׳</he>, read: <cite ref="E00566"><he>ההֲלָכָה</he></cite>, v.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:10:8">Y. Keth. II, end, 27ᵃ</cite>.]—Pl. <he>הֲלִיכוֹת</he>.
